title: AtomEgo: Exploring Ego-Robot Integration for Embodied Foundation Model Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2609.21461v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied foundation models are constrained by the limited scale and diversity of robot demonstrations, motivating the use of large-scale egocentric human interaction data. However, how to effectively incorporate such data into embodied-model pre-training remains unclear because of substantial embodiment and action-space gaps between humans and robots. We present AtomEgo, a systematic study of ego--robot co-training supported by a curated corpus of approximately 2,659 hours and a scalable data processing pipeline. Across vision--language--action and world--action model architectures, we investigate three representative paradigms: joint co-training with domain-specific action heads, progressive ego-to-robot transfer through embodiment alignment, and joint video--action modeling. translated_title: AtomEgo：探索自我-机器人融合的具身基础模型预训练
translated_abstract: 具身基础模型受到机器人演示数据规模和多样性有限的制约，这促使研究者利用大规模的第一人称视角人类交互数据。然而，由于人类与机器人之间存在显著的具身形态差异和动作空间差异，如何有效地将此类数据融入具身模型预训练仍不明确。我们提出了AtomEgo，这是一项关于自我-机器人协同训练的系统性研究，其依托约2,659小时的精心整理语料库和可扩展的数据处理流水线。在视觉-语言-动作和世界-动作两种模型架构上，我们研究了三种代表性范式：采用领域特定动作头的联合协同训练、通过具身对齐实现的渐进式自我到机器人迁移，以及联合视频-动作建模。我们通过多任务真实机器人实验和语言条件下的跨具身表征分析来评估这些范式。我们的结果揭示了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出AtomEgo系统研究自我-机器人协同训练，利用约2,659小时第一人称人类交互数据和可扩展数据处理流水线，探索三种融合范式以弥合人类与机器人之间的具身差距，从而提升具身基础模型的预训练效果。
en_tdlr: AtomEgo presents a systematic study of ego-robot co-training for embodied foundation model pretraining, leveraging ~2,659 hours of curated egocentric human data and a scalable pipeline to explore three integration paradigms that bridge the embodiment gap between humans and robots.
